segments.text:
V. 15.
The children of the bride-chamber —The Companions of the Bridegroom. Mourn—Mourning and Faſting uſually go together. As if He had ſaid, While I am with them, it is a Feſtival Time, a Seaſon of Rejoicing, not Mourning. But after I am gone, all my Diſciples likewiſe ſhall be in faſtings often.
